card.line: Philippi was a leading Roman colony in Macedonia, where the gospel first took root in Europe and where Paul planted a church that stayed close to him.

moments.title: Lydia believes
moments.text: On the Sabbath, Paul and his friends spoke to women gathered by the river outside the city gate. The Lord opened the heart of Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth, and she and her household were baptized.

moments.title: A spirit leaves a slave girl
moments.text: A slave girl with a spirit of divination followed Paul for many days. Paul commanded the spirit in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her, and it left at that moment.

moments.title: Suffering before Thessalonica
moments.text: Paul later reminded the Thessalonians that he and his team had suffered and been shamefully treated in Philippi. Even so, they boldly spoke the gospel of God.

moments.title: Paul sails from Philippi
moments.text: After the Feast of Unleavened Bread, Paul and his companions sailed from Philippi. Five days later they reached Troas and stayed seven days.

moments.title: A letter to the saints
moments.text: Paul and Timothy wrote to the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with their overseers and deacons. Paul thanked God for their partnership in the gospel from the first day.
